name: chronoflow
description: Todo app and time tracker with Jira integration

scripts.dev: concurrently -k --handle-input -n main,renderer "npm run dev:main" "npm run dev:renderer"
scripts.build: npm run build:main && npm run build:renderer

releaseInfo.releaseNotes:
### ChronoFlow v0.1.7

#### New Features:
- **Notch auto-hide:** the notch timer now tucks away at the top of the screen and slides down when your mouse approaches — perfect for remote-desktop-style setups.
- **Multi-monitor notch:** choose which screen the notch appears on via Settings → Appearance → Notch screen.
- **Vacation page:** log Jira "verlof" tickets from the new /vacation page, with defaults for hours per workday and a default ticket key in Settings.

#### Fixes:
- **Jira worklog timestamps:** synced times now use your local timezone offset instead of a hardcoded UTC stamp, which Jira Cloud rejected.
- **Idle detection:** setting the idle threshold to "Off" now truly disables AFK prompts, and suspend/lock events are forwarded to the timer overlay too.
- **Idle entries crossing midnight** are split per day so daily totals stay accurate.
- **Timer overlay search** now loads Jira connections on focus, preventing a race where the first search returned nothing.
- DevTools no longer open automatically when running `npm run dev`.
